question: Which bracketed operations dominate instrumented GPU relation-query block cycles on the fixed large affine inputs?

claims.text: All 30 replay cells preserve the full protocol replies for the same eight-query prefix of each fixed 63-bit input.
Stage cycle shares, CUDA event durations and instrumentation overhead are descriptive L0 diagnostics; no production time partition or speedup claim.

arms.description: Stock persistent affine kernel with event timing
Staged full-cache diagnostic kernel with block clocks and event timing

positive.not_applicable_reason: Before data, exact planted hits, minimum IDs and independent CPU relation replay run through both stock and staged kernels. These validation fixtures are not timed study arms.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Before data, CPU-exhausted misses, tail coverage and empty/infinity cases must agree across kernels; memcheck/racecheck/synccheck must pass.

factors.name: source_and_build
factors.value: One CUDA13.2 sm_89 -O3 -lineinfo binary for b/s/x; only runtime mode changes
factors.how: Capture uses a separate uninstrumented build of the same source; all responses compared bytewise.

factors.name: inputs
factors.value: First8 actual queries from each prior63-bit seed101/202 input
factors.how: Transparent Rust proxy records real service requests and responses; no selection by timing or hit outcome.

factors.name: host
factors.how: One RTX4090, source/binary hashes, GPU state, CPU identity; L0 shared host.

factors.name: memory_layout
factors.how: Fresh-process ASLR; same full-cache/filter/index policy and original full table sizes.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Five rounds per seed: b/s/x on even rounds, x/s/b on odd. All process setup cold; clocks reported only for search kernel.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Strict frozen Rust analyzer retains all cells; no significance testing.

comparisons.threshold: All30 cells and8 queries each; exact protocol response equality.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Five b/s/x then x/s/b alternating rounds per seed; stock repeat brackets stages.

seed_derivation.note: Exactly101/202, existing63-bit input files copied unchanged; driver RNG unchanged.

instance_sampling.rule: Use both prior63-bit affine inputs and first8 queries from each; full tables unchanged. Prefix scope chosen before data.

blinding.how: Descriptive instrumentation, not inferential analysis; labels not masked.

power.note: Fixed8-query prefixes on2 inputs,5 rounds and stock repeat. No population inference or test of speedup; sample supports descriptive repeat range only.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Prior queries averaged roughly0.09-0.17s; instrumentation and cold full-table preparation are unknown. Fixed4200s worker and4500s controller cap; <=0.90/hour one4090. No adaptive sample count.

primary.name: Exact query outcomes
primary.definition: Eight iff the complete protocol response stream equals captured uninstrumented responses, exit0 and all eight profile/coverage records exist.

secondary.name: Search kernel event interval
secondary.definition: CUDA events immediately before and after search kernel on default stream; no setup, resolution, copies or host launch time included.

secondary.name: Stage block elapsed cycles
secondary.definition: Thread0 clock64 differences between fenced block barriers, summed over tiles and blocks. Includes scheduling and instrumentation; not wall time. Empty interval retained without subtraction.

record: All command transcripts, replies, logs and profiler statuses
Source and binary hashes; ptxas registers/spills
Raw per-query stage clocks and kernel events; all30 cells, including failures

stopping_rules.rule: 2 fixed63-bit inputs x5 rounds x3 arms x8 prefix queries =30 cells/240 queries. Capture ends intentionally after8 replies. No retry, expansion or input changes.

Preflight failure stops before data. Per cell/capture600s, sanitizer180s, profiler600s,worker4200/controller4500. Preserve all partial records. Optional profiler failures retained, not invented; no counter permission bypass.

invalidation_rules: Any reply mismatch, wrong minimum, coverage mismatch, sanitizer failure or missing planned cell invalidates complete panel. Optional hardware-profiler unsupported/timeout does not erase block-clock data; retain limitation.

decision_rule.text: Report exact reply equality; aggregate each stage cycle sum over40 staged queries per seed, divide by total including empty. Report cycles/tile, per-round stock repeat spread and staged/mean(stock,repeat) event-duration ratio. Instrumented fractions never applied to historical oracle seconds.
decision_rule.interval: Five per-round baseline relative spreads, not a confidence interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Instrumented event time / mean of stock repeats; stage block cycle share including empty interval

graphs: Instrumented block-cycle shares for both seeds, empty control included

inadmissible: Calling prefix execution a complete recovery
Converting concurrent block-cycle totals or shares into production seconds
Treating instrumented kernel time as a throughput or speedup result
Silently skipping failed cells or counter permission failures

literature.claim: Large affine runs are dominated by query oracle; arithmetic count omits conversion normalization and index memory costs.
Per-SM cycle intervals include time slicing; they are not instruction execution cost.
Replay/cache controls and metric collection perturb kernels; source counters and occupancy can explain costs if supported.
